Image Description: The image depicts a wide expanse of water under a dynamic sky filled with clouds. The water appears to be a large lake or coastal area, with gentle ripples and small waves indicating light wind activity. In the distance, a faint shoreline is visible, lined with low-lying vegetation and possibly some structures, though they are indistinct due to the distance.

Above the water, three kites are flying in the sky. Two of them are curved, C-shaped kites typical
